name: qanda-fullstack
description: QandA fullstack: user web, admin web, Node.js TypeScript Express API, MySQL.

scripts.setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate:deploy && npm run db:seed && npm run db:import
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace user-web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace user-web && npm run build --workspace admin-web
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build
scripts.release: npm run clean && npm run check && node scripts/create-release.mjs
scripts.setup:dev: npm run db:generate:dev && npm run db:push:dev && npm run db:seed:dev && npm run db:import:dev
scripts.prod:check: npm run check && npm run prisma:migrate:status --workspace server
scripts.setup:prod: npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate:deploy && npm run db:seed && npm run db:import
scripts.local:bootstrap: npm run docker:dev && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run setup:dev
scripts.local:reset-db: npm run docker:dev:down && npm run docker:dev && npm run setup:dev
scripts.dev:local: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace user-web" "npm run dev --workspace admin-web"
scripts.local:dev: npm run local:bootstrap && npm run dev
scripts.prod:prepare: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run db:generate && npm run build
